edit.description: deleteBranch: replace the /not found/.test(stderr) match on git's own message with a structural check (ref-existence probe or the delete's documented exit status) per Told, not inferred.
Pin deleteBranch as a no-op on a missing branch when git's stderr is not English.

summary: deleteBranch stops inferring 'branch missing' from git's localized stderr prose; keys off structure instead.
tests: deleteBranch on a missing branch resolves without throwing regardless of git's configured output locale
acceptance: deleteBranch(repoRoot, missingBranch) is a no-op under a non-English git locale, verified structurally rather than by stderr pattern
notes: src/git.ts:178-190. Ask git directly (rev-parse --verify / show-ref, or the delete's own exit status) rather than matching /not found/ against localized text. A platform-facts.md doc note is optional human follow-up — .claude/rules/** is outside build's writablePaths.
